pt, and interactive graph visualizer
# DSH OKF Plugin (`dsh-okf`)
A production-ready DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin implementing the **Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2)
-ready DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin implementing the **Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2)** standard.
Instead of unstructured chunks and probabilistic embeddings that cause agent hallucinations, OKF mod
els complex systems as a **verifiable, deterministic knowledge graph of Markdown documents with stri
ct YAML frontmatter, backlinks, freshness tracking, and audit trails**.
## Features

- **6 DSH Agent Tools**:
- `okf_init`: Initialize a standards-compliant OKF v0.2 bundle (`index.md`,

`log.md`, starter concepts).
- `okf_validate`: Deterministic linter checking frontmatter, required

`type`, broken links, orphan concepts, and stale status.
- `okf_search`: Search concepts by keyword,

type, tag, or verification status.
- `okf_concept_read`: Read concept frontmatter, markdown body, a

nd computed incoming backlinks.
- `okf_concept_write`: Create or update concept files with frontmatt

er validation and automatic audit logging in `log.md`.
- `okf_visualize`: Export interactive force-d
irected HTML graph (`viz.html`) powered by Cytoscape.js.

- **Interactive Web UI & REST API**:
- `GET /api/okf/view`: Full-screen browser visualizer with sear

ch, category filtering, layout switching, and inspector sidebar.
- `GET /api/okf/graph`: Cytoscape-c

ompatible JSON graph (nodes, edges, backlinks, metadata).
- `GET /api/okf/status`: Health and confor
mance stats for the active workspace.

- **DSH System Prompt & Skill Integration**:
- Bundled DSH skill under `skills/okf/SKILL.md`.
- Inje
cts runtime guidance into DSH agent context so the agent automatically uses OKF practices.
